
''runbau''

----

Short form for ''[[jbocre: constructed language|constructed language]]'', human languages which are not [[jbocre: natural language|natural language]]s.  Sometimes divided into three groups:

* [[jbocre: artlang|artlang]]s, those devised for artistic purposes -- either per se, or for use in fiction.
** [[jbocre: Klingon|Klingon]]

** [http://www.uib.no/People/hnohf/ olkien languages], which have given us [[jbocre: tengwar|tengwar]]
** [[jbocre: Láadan]]

** [http://www.invisiblelighthouse.com/langlab/glaugnea.html laugnea]
** [[jbocre: Solresol|Solresol]]

***Really for artistic ''purposes''?  Its purpose seems to have been IAL, the "esthetic" side -- the musical version -- was partly practical (tone carries farther than words and is easier to pick out in a noisy environment) and partly either a bad joke or a misunderstanding of the claim that music is the universal language (which is clearly false even when rightly understood). pc
* [[jbocre: loglang|loglang]]s, more recently called ''[[jbocre: engelang ngelangs|engelang ngelangs]]'' (Engineered languages), those devised according to some sort of objective principles; [[jbocre: Lojban Description|Lojban Description]] is one of these.

* [[jbocre: auxlang|auxlang]]s, those devised principally as [[jbocre: auxlang AL|auxlang AL]]s
** ''a posteriori''

*** [[jbocre: Esperanto|Esperanto]]
*** [http://www.basiceng.com/ asic English]

*** [http://cheshire.net/~jjbowks/auxiling/_intglos.html nterglossa]
*** [http://www.geocities.com/Athens/Olympus/2948/ atino sine Flexione]

*** [http://www.interlingua.com/ nterlingua]
*** [http://members.aol.com/dkcsac/myhomepage/romanova.htm omanova]

*** [[jbocre: New conlang ondlango|New conlang ondlango]]
** [[jbocre: Ygyde|Ygyde]]

** [http://www.unish.org nish]
** [[jbocre: Inoffensish|Inoffensish]]

** ''a priori''
*** [[jbocre: Sona|Sona]] ''(except for some borrowed radicals)''

*** ''ru'a lo me la'o ly. [[jbocre: a priori|a priori]] .ly bangu ka'e se pilno fi le nu satci cusku lo smuni be lo gismu''

These categories are of course overlapping.
